spans.note: The prompt strongly and repeatedly emphasizes truthfulness and data integrity. It explicitly forbids hallucinating numbers, math, or figure interpretations, requires using exact values from logs, mandates citing only verified keys from refs.bib, and requires reading abstracts to write accurate citation sentences rather than generic ones.

The prompt includes an anti-leakage mechanism that prevents disclosure of author names, emails, and affiliations. It runs an anti-leakage post-check script and instructs the use of 'Anonymous Authors' for double-blind review, demonstrating concern for privacy in the academic submission context.
